workflows.yaml:
version: '1'
name: Fraud Case Creation
description: >
  Creates an Elastic case from a completed, risk-rated fraud investigation.
  Generic across domains - banking, securities, or cross-domain.
enabled: true
tags:
  - fraud
  - case
  - reporting

inputs:
  - name: case_title
    type: string
    required: true
    description: Short case title including the primary scenario and top account, e.g. "Securities Layering - Christopher Martinez ring"
  - name: severity
    type: string
    required: true
    description: The category returned by the Fraud Risk Rating workflow - one of low, medium, high, critical (lowercase)
  - name: rating_rationale
    type: string
    required: true
    description: The rationale returned by the Fraud Risk Rating workflow
  - name: findings_summary
    type: string
    required: true
    description: Executive summary of the investigation in 2-4 sentences
  - name: top_findings
    type: string
    required: true
    description: Markdown list of the top 3-5 findings - each with account name, scenario/typology matched, key metrics, and brokers involved if any
  - name: domain
    type: string
    required: true
    description: One of banking, securities, cross-domain (used as a case tag)

triggers:
  - type: manual

steps:
  - name: check_inputs
    type: if
    condition: "inputs.case_title: * and inputs.severity: * and inputs.findings_summary: * and inputs.top_findings: * and inputs.domain: *"
    steps:
      - name: open_case
        type: cases.createCase
        with:
          title: "[{{ inputs.severity }}] {{ inputs.case_title }}"
          description: "## Fraud Investigation - {{ inputs.domain }}\n\n{{ inputs.findings_summary }}\n\n### Risk assessment\n**Rating:** {{ inputs.severity }}\n\n{{ inputs.rating_rationale }}\n\n### Top findings\n\n{{ inputs.top_findings }}\n\n---\n*Opened automatically by an AI fraud analysis agent. Findings are investigative leads for human SAR/STR review, not determinations of misconduct.*"
          tags:
            - fraud
            - automated-triage
            - "{{ inputs.domain }}"
            - "{{ inputs.severity }}"
          owner: securitySolution
          severity: "{{ inputs.severity }}"
          settings:
            syncAlerts: false
    else:
      - name: reject_incomplete
        type: console
        with:
          message: "CASE CREATION REJECTED: one or more required inputs were empty (case_title, severity, findings_summary, top_findings, domain). No case was created. Rate the findings first, then retry with all inputs populated."
